blurb: ABC Bicycle and Jet Ski Rentals offers jet ski rentals with Yamaha VX110 watercraft, including training on safe use and boating rules. They provide life jackets and trailers with gas cans. They also offer bicycle sales, parts, and repair services with various tune-up packages.
extraNote: $75 deposit required to reserve jet ski, credited to rental fee · Cancellations outside 7 days get full refund minus 15% fee · Cancellations 3-7 days get refund only if reservation filled, else deposit forfeited · Cancellations less than 3 days forfeit deposit · Damage deposit required on pre-authorized credit card at rental time · No jet ski operation in less than 3-4 feet of water to avoid damage
